questions.q: Which actor first played Tony in 2008's Iron Man?
questions.why: Robert Downey Jr. played Tony Stark in the first MCU film.

questions.q: Which weapons manufacturing company does Tony run?
questions.why: Stark Industries was his weapons company, later Stark International.

questions.q: Which executive assistant eventually becomes CEO of Tony's firm?
questions.why: Pepper Potts rose from assistant to CEO.

questions.q: In the original 1963 comics, in which war is Tony wounded and captured?
questions.why: The original setting was the Vietnam War.

questions.q: What does Tony install to treat the heart injury an explosion gives his assistant?
questions.why: After a blast hurt her heart as his had been hurt, he fitted her with arc reactor tech.

questions.q: Which recurring nemesis of Iron Man first appeared in Tales of Suspense #50 (1964)?
questions.why: The Mandarin debuted in Tales of Suspense #50.

questions.q: James Rhodes briefly replaced Tony in the armor, then adopted which armored name?
Which business rival of Tony becomes the Iron Monger?
questions.why: Obadiah Stane became the Iron Monger.

questions.q: Which 1979 Iron Man storyline dealt with Tony's struggle with alcoholism?
questions.why: Demon in a Bottle (1979) made Stark an alcoholic.

questions.q: In 1987-88's 'Armor Wars,' which arms dealer sells Tony's tech to villains?
questions.why: Justin Hammer distributed Iron Man's armor technology.
